businessContact.emailStatus: kcr@sdsu.edu is a first-party, purpose-labelled institutional music-submission mailbox. Current music-director and promotions addresses were verified but excluded to prevent duplicate or unauthorized routing.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The authorized route is email, but a human must inspect the exact message and audio asset and resolve unpublished technical, eligibility, rights and AI-origin rules before sending.

activityVerification.evidence: KCR's official site exposes live-listening access and a current management roster. Its homepage published multiple artist interviews and reviews on July 7, 2026, and additional official music coverage appeared throughout 2026.

genreFitEvidence: KCR describes its station as eclectic and focused on curated music from up-and-coming artists.
Current 2026 editorial coverage includes electronic festivals, alternative rock, indie, lo-fi and trip-hop-adjacent music.
Selected clean MarcsMusic electronic, alternative-leaning, melodic bass, world-fusion or accessible reggae-adjacent material has plausible fit, subject to human selection.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is first-party, direct and fee-free as published, but international eligibility, delivery limits, technical MP3 requirements, rights, release timing and AI-origin rules remain unpublished. Human track, asset and message review is mandatory.
